opis: The edge of the little pond on the meadow from the reference picture, a sunny afternoon. The OWL has laid her child's crayon DRAWING (a sun, a little house with a red roof, a tree) on a flat stone right by the water. The pond's surface GLOWS with silver magical sparkles and soft rings, and out of the water a SECOND drawing of the same size is rising, dripping, shimmering in the sparkles - from here the two drawings look alike, their small details lost in the glow. The OWL jumps back in surprise, wings up, eyes wide, beak open. Magical and funny, not scary.
